dict.string: my-island sends Apple Events to verify Automation permission and, in later phases, to reveal the iTerm2 pane of a waiting Claude Code session.

my-island samples the system audio output level to animate the collapsed-notch sound-wave while music is playing. Audio is never recorded, stored, or transmitted — only a live loudness value drives the bars.
my-island reads your calendar to show a countdown to your next meeting and a one-click join link.
